reason: This is the already-refuted fix (b) with a two-word prefix, and driving the proposed CSS verbatim in the master shows it failing on its own terms three ways. (1) The premise is wrong. The panel does not name its moment 'only in the accessibility tree': .b-item[data-editing="true"] .b-copy paints the edited row with a fore-06 wash and a 12px halo, and that row's title is on screen in every case measured (desk top 570 with the panel top at 597; 1023 top 67; 390 top 64) - and the panel's own first field is labelled 'What it is' holding the title. A sighted owner already sees the name twice, once held and once editable. (2) The proposal is refutation (b) again. Injected and measured at 1440: row title 570, proposed head 631, title input value 708 - the same string three times inside 138px of vertical span - and it is hidden by [data-undo="true"] exactly when a change has been made. Worse than the version already refuted: paintUndo sets data-undo on the root and only removes it when the history stack empties, so after ONE stepper press the head is hidden for the rest of the session. Measured: close the panel, open a different moment, and the head for 'Editing - Final dress fitting' computes visibility: hidden while the band above it still reads 'Menu tasting at The Orchard moved 7 days later.' The band's only visible naming then names the wrong moment and the void is back - the fix delivers its heading only in the pristine pre-first-edit state and never again. (3) The declared style does not exist. --size-micro and --track-micro are not in the lock (the ramp is label/labelWide/data/body/lead/date/head/title/titleWide/figure/card/count/countWide; the tracking ladder is label/labelWide/data/body/head/title/display). The font shorthand is therefore invalid at computed-value time: the element computes Geist sans, 17px, letter-spacing normal, line-height 25.5px - uppercase SANS at the lead size with off-ramp tracking, one step larger than the input beneath it. It renders 64px tall against the 50px band, so at rest its hairline crosses the first label at 686 while its own box ends at 695. The one thing the fix promises - 'the 88/104px never moves' - is the first thing it breaks. Three consecutive raises of this band have now produced foot-mounting (undo off screen, behind Delete), name-filling, and name-filling with a prefix and two invented tokens. The reserve at rest is a held space for the one reversibility surface, sized to it and measured; a blank 88px is the price of the stepper not moving under a repeat press, which round 1 already paid for. Nothing here is a better answer.
